external_deps: A supported coding agent (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, etc.)

review.tagline: Skill set that enforces a plan-and-TDD workflow in coding agents
review.summary: Superpowers is a library of composable skills plus a bootstrap skill (using-superpowers) that makes a coding agent brainstorm a spec, write a task plan, and implement it with subagents under red/green TDD and code review. It installs as a plugin or extension for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Copilot CLI, OpenCode, Pi and others. Skills trigger automatically.
review.audience: Developers who run coding agents and want a enforced spec, plan and TDD process
strengths: Installs via plugin marketplaces or one command on 15+ listed agent harnesses
Covers the full loop: brainstorming, worktrees, plans, subagent execution, review, branch finish
diagnosing-superpowers skill reads session transcripts and can export a scrubbed bug bundle
MIT licensed, with eval harness and plugin tests in the repo
weaknesses: Workflows are mandatory, so small tasks go through the same process
Subagent-driven mode costs more tokens than inline execution
Install is per harness; each agent needs separate setup
Optional visual companion loads a vendor-hosted logo that reports version unless disabled by env var
